content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of games with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription option suitable for the whole family, but it's not the only choice. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, you can directly access a large number of excellent iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan now comes with a large library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the cheapest "Standard with ads" plan at $8.99 per month.

Regardless of which Netflix plan you've chosen, you can play mobile and TV games with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix provides a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller to play games on supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to upgrade your mobile gaming experience, a truly dedicated iPhone game controller would be the best choice.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app designed specifically for kids, called Netflix Playground, which contains mini-games. Additionally, there are Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond these, Netflix also supports a game library of over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download these games from the App Store and log in with your Netflix email and password to play.
